All of the animals at Kindness Ranch Animal Sanctuary have previously been used in laboratory research. We have a small but hardworking staff, all of who live on site to provide the animals with the best possible hands-on care.

Some of our experienced staff members live with the dogs and work daily on socialization, crate-training, housebreaking, leash-walking, and basic commands. The cats receive an abundance of play time, trees for climbing, an outdoor space for exploring, and socialization with other cats and visitors.

Our horses and other farm animals also receive daily care and socialization. The horses and cows are free to roam most of our 1,000 acres, and the sheep and pigs have access to open grazing land, as well. These animals are visitor favorites and will likely live out their lives at Kindness Ranch.
